evals.name: notification-settings
evals.prompt: Build a polished notification-settings panel for a professional planning app called Orbit. Deliver a standalone index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript, no external dependencies or assets. Include three labeled notification toggles, a daily-summary time field, save feedback, a simulated save failure with retry, and a cancel/reset action. Make it usable on desktop and mobile. Use fictional content and local state only. Include a short DESIGN.md explaining choices and any unverified behavior. Do not browse or use unrelated skills.
evals.expected_output: Working responsive settings UI with coherent design, complete save/recovery flow, keyboard controls and thoughtful motion.
assertions: No external network assets or runtime dependencies are required.
At 390px and 1280px the page has no horizontal overflow or runtime errors.
Every interactive control has an accessible name; automated serious/critical accessibility findings are absent.
A reduced-motion preference disables nonessential spatial motion.
Three notification controls and a labeled summary-time field can be changed; reset restores saved values.
Simulated save failure is visible, retry reaches success, and the interface remains usable.

evals.name: document-explorer
evals.prompt: Build a polished document explorer for a research app called Index. Deliver standalone index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript, no external dependencies or assets. Show six fictional documents, a search field, category filters, selectable document details, and an empty-results reset action. Make the selected document and its details usable on desktop and mobile. Use local state only. Include a short DESIGN.md explaining choices and any unverified behavior. Do not browse or use unrelated skills.
evals.expected_output: Distinctive responsive document discovery UI with search, filter, selection, recoverable empty state, accessible controls and purposeful transitions.
assertions: No external network assets or runtime dependencies are required.
At 390px and 1280px the page has no horizontal overflow or runtime errors.
Every interactive control has an accessible name; automated serious/critical accessibility findings are absent.
A reduced-motion preference disables nonessential spatial motion.
Search and category filtering change the displayed documents; no-results offers a working reset.
Selecting a document exposes its details at desktop and mobile widths.
